description: Sparse (1,000 recipes, fan-out 1) and dense (500 recipes, fan-out 8) dependency graphs.
ceiling: Depth and fan-out are both bounded. Edge count is producer x consumer, so an unbounded dense corpus makes the benchmark the pathology it measures; and layoutGraph cycle detection is a recursive unguarded DFS, so an unbounded chain stack-overflows first.

graph.buildRecipeGraph.sparse.description: Producer/consumer edge derivation over the bounded sparse corpus.

graph.layoutGraph.sparse.description: Layered layout + edge paths over the bounded sparse graph.

graph.buildRecipeGraph.dense.description: Producer/consumer edge derivation over the bounded dense corpus.

graph.layoutGraph.dense.description: Layered layout + edge paths over the bounded dense graph.
